Summary: The baseline model for 2WikiMultiHopQA dataset achieved the following results in Table 5: Answer Sp EM F1 were 36.53, 43.93, 24.99, and 65.26 respectively on the test set; Joint EM F1 were 1.07, 14.94, 0.35, and 5.41 for Comparison, Inference, Compositional, and Bridge-Comparison question types respectively. The baseline model's performance on different types of questions is detailed in Table 6, showing EM F1 scores ranging from 12.40 to 65.02. The paper also mentions that the evidence generation task is particularly challenging, with baseline models achieving only 1.07% exact match accuracy and 14.94% F1 score on this task.
